cause.scope: Retained stale-map data plus a minimal core persistence reproducer; not a claim about all stock BIM windows or the historical file's authoring origin.
cause.pattern: Saved raw hashed names have lost their backing StringIDs. Full recompute regenerates a raw name for a different vertex; the apparently valid match bypasses geometry migration because the saved element-map version still appears current.
cause.fix: Detect missing saved hash-prefix identities in PropertyPartShape::afterRestore and invalidate the restored map version, requesting the existing geometry-based reference migration on the next shape change. Do not clear links or assign dimension points.
cause.historical_name_loss_origin: Not proven; preventative cross-hasher investigation tracked separately in FreeCAD-ute.

verification.minimal_regression_before_fix: Failed: References changed from (Vertex1, Vertex2) to (Vertex2, Vertex2), 0.075 seconds.
verification.minimal_and_valid_identity_control_after: 2 passed, 0.079 seconds; saved/cold-reopened/recomputed missing-hash references retain physical points, while a valid identity still follows its new vertex.
verification.retained_full_recompute_and_save: Passed, 66.854 seconds; both dimensions retain Vertex43/Vertex10, their original start/end coordinates, and 778 mm projected spans.
verification.retained_fresh_process_reopen_and_two_fu: Passed, 70.597 seconds; both spans 778 mm in all three snapshots and original points retained within 1e-7 mm.
verification.serialization_caveat: CLI in-memory BREP serialization may differ with tiny floating-point changes; physical coordinates, not byte equality, are the correctness assertion.

ctest.exclusion_reason: Existing user FreeCAD GUI PID97999 remained running and was not touched; these native-app tests can collide with its process-global GUI IPC.

retained_probe_runs.result: Both passed all six dimension/cycle assertions, including direct linked vertex coordinates rather than only cached Draft endpoints. Each process checks restored state and two forced recomputes, then saves a distinct successor.

delivery_boundary.remaining_acceptance: Save/close the user's existing FreeCAD session, install a build containing this fix, rerun the retained probe with that installed identity, and hand evidence to Oomakhi for its native affected-workflow rerun and drawing review. Source verification does not accept or close the EN2 building-delivery obligation.
